3009.title: ACP bridge fails a typed busy prompt instead of retrying after idle
3009.rootCauseOneLine: Current ACP bridge preserves busy data only in error text and fails the turn through the generic path; two clean synthetic runs show bounded caller-driven refusals and explicit-next-turn recovery, not an automatic retry storm.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff handles the verified typed error and idle transition. This report did not run the pull request.

3009.proposedFix: Keep typed error data, retry only the exact busy response after a valid idle update, and enforce one retry with a timeout.
3009.caveats: 2026-09-30: five selected tests pass in each clean current-main checkout. Synthetic idle metadata is not a verified OMP extension contract. Server retry loop, queue and real provider race remain untested. PR3004 is closed unmerged; historical static review retained.
